summary: Build evidence-based decision skills with dashboards, decision logs, and recommendation tools. Enroll to improve management outcomes.
lede: Decision intelligence and evidence-based management turns data, expert judgment, and organizational context into decisions supported by traceable evidence. This course develops practical skills in decision framing, evidence evaluation, KPI selection, visualization, root-cause analysis, and recommendation design using tools such as Tableau and Power BI. You will learn to build evidence matrices, dashboards, decision logs, and decision memos while applying data quality checks, decision criteria, bias awareness, and governance controls. The course also introduces predictive analytics and AI-assisted decision support, helping professionals produce credible, auditable recommendations despite incomplete data, competing targets, and fast reporting demands.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to improve how decisions are framed, evidenced, justified, and communicated across functions.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in business operations, reporting, analysis, planning, or management decision support. A basic understanding of Excel, KPI reporting, and simple data interpretation is helpful; no coding is required. If you work with dashboards, management reports, business cases, or committee papers, you will have enough context to apply the course immediately. Advanced analytics concepts are covered at an operational and conceptual level, not as technical engineering or model-building work.
